verdict.rationale: Figma exposes broad but not fully-parity API surfaces: the REST API is largely read/extract plus webhooks, the Plugin API supports read/write within the plugin sandbox, and the new MCP server can write to canvas and generate code/designs, but these are separate, partially-overlapping mechanisms rather than a single API that mirrors every UI action (e.g. full prototyping, animation, FigJam collaboration features are not exposed as controllable API operations). Community feedback also notes real friction points (manual SVG export, no bulk API equivalent, Dev Mode paywalled) confirming gaps versus UI capability. Missing for 10: a unified API/SDK with documented parity for prototyping, animation, and FigJam actions, and independent confirmation that Plugin/REST/MCP APIs together cover the full UI feature set.
